title: Negative-History Cushion on Northloop Payments Card Settlements
content:
**Rule.** A seller-authorised card settlement of a negative Northloop Payments balance carries a negative-history cushion. The negative-history cushion is 50.00 USD when a card charge for a negative balance was declined in the last twelve months, 25.00 USD when card charges for a negative balance were made in the last twelve months and none was declined, and nothing when none was made. It is added unchanged to the settlement basis as topped up, and the card settlement amount so obtained is rounded to the cent.

A window of the last twelve months takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day twelve months before the settlement date, up to and including the settlement date. The card charges counted are the card charge entries for a negative balance on the account's ledger, each showing whether it succeeded or was declined.

| Card charges for a negative balance in the last twelve months | Negative-history cushion |
|---|---|
| at least one declined | 50.00 USD |
| one or more made, none declined | 25.00 USD |
| none made | nothing |

*Hypothetical cases.* Two charges in the window, one declined and one succeeded: 50.00 USD. One succeeded charge eight months before the settlement date: 25.00 USD. One declined charge thirteen months before and none since: outside the window, so nothing.
